## Ctx.userIsBot property

Indicates whether the current sender is a bot account.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get userIsBot(): boolean;
```

## Remarks

Returns `false` if the bot status is not available.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  if (this.userIsBot) {
    return // Ignore bot messages
  }
}
```
